NORTH.title: Northern temperament
NORTH.body: Altitude writes the script — mist cuffs ridges, scooters carry soup steam uphill, afternoons dissolve into train-whistle echoes. Gradients stay cool; accents borrow pine and kiln smoke.

CENTRAL.title: Central choreography
CENTRAL.body: Sea salt stitches fabric to lanterns; sandstone drinks heat then exhales it at dusk. Horizons stay wide; palettes warm toward copper.

SOUTH.title: Southern resonance
SOUTH.body: Tropical inertia meets voltage — jasmine competes with LED, deltas braid patience with commerce. Typography can stretch taller; overlays lean sunset without shouting sale.

hero.title: A manifesto folded into fog, lanterns, and the sound of spoons on tin.
hero.subtitle: We are not a booking desk. We are a magazine-minded companion for travelers who want Vietnam to unfold like a documentary written in humidity and light — slow, tactile, fiercely local.

philosophy.title: Discovering Vietnam quietly, on purpose
philosophy.p1: The country refuses a single storyline. Alley kitchens braid with lantern dusk; mountain fog rinses terraces until they look like graphite sketches; coastal highways hum with salt and karaoke bleeding from storefronts.
philosophy.p1_emphasis: Đất Việt chooses slowness: letting place arrive before itineraries, honoring food as culture's first handshake, insisting that hidden pockets remain hidden until you earn them with footsteps.
philosophy.p2: Cinematic travel, for us, is not spectacle — it’s fidelity to sensory truth. Noise, drizzle, incense, jasmine tea cooling in small cups — the palette of immersion is ordinary until you decide to listen.

block1.title: Routes chosen for texture, not checklists
block1.body: Journeys read like folded magazine features — glimpses through kitchen steam, scooters threading markets, ridges that blush at sunset. Commerce never steers us; longing does.

block2.title: Images as handwriting, captions as whisper
block2.body: Photography here is pacing: wide shots for longing, tighter frames when detail matters — knuckles on a phin press, rainwater collecting in a tarp’s fold. Typography keeps the narration human; interface stays recessive so the atmosphere can lead.

sensory_section.title: Vietnam, taught through sensation
sensory_section.intro: These are not “features”. They’re the tonal notes we keep returning to when we edit light, copy, and motion — the evidence that travel here is orchestral, never flat.

alley_kitchens.label: Alley kitchens
alley_kitchens.line: Charcoal hiss behind corrugated doors — supper before introductions.

lantern_streets.label: Lantern streets
lantern_streets.line: Silk light pooled on pavers, tailoring conversations to a softer tempo.

coffee_culture.label: Coffee culture
coffee_culture.line: Egg foam, phin drip, condensation on glass — the pause between chapters.

mountain_fog.label: Mountain fog
mountain_fog.line: Terraces erased and redrawn by breath; ridges appear like ink bleeding through paper.

coastal_roads.label: Coastal roads

manifesto.quote_lead: Travel owes you memory, not velocity. Vietnam rewards the curious who accept humidity as a pause mark, detours as grace notes, and strangers’ chopsticks tapping rhythm against tin bowls as percussion for the night.
manifesto.quote_body: This land deserves cinematic patience — lanterns measured in breathing room, ridges allowed to veil and unveil, narratives that concede commerce is peripheral to appetite, sound, devotion, and dusk.
manifesto.quote_emphasis: We keep discovery human: no dashboards masquerading as poetry, no engine noise where a story should be whispered.

closing.title: Stay longer in the margins than the marquee.
closing.body: Let alley steam write your captions. Follow mountains until they blush. Carry this magazine spirit into night markets you did not rehearse — we built Đất Việt so those nights have a quieter map.

intro.title: Exploration edited like film — scenes, breath, texture
intro.p1_lead: Vietnam refuses to be reduced into bullet points.
intro.p1_strong: The voices gathered here are not ‘staff’ — they are craftspeople who treat travel as sensory ethics: listen longer than the itinerary allows, eat where steam replaces signage, document without stealing dignity.
intro.p2: Read these chapters as interviews without microphones — faces lit by kitchen fog, coastlines humming through cheap headphones, notebooks softened by humidity. This is the crew behind the feelings you meet on every route we publish.

interlude.quote: We do not ‘lead’ Vietnam from a slide deck — we follow it with notebooks fogged by broth steam, microphones kissed by tide, and lenses cleaned with the hem of a shirt because the moment refused to wait.

parallax_mid.title: Fog as collaborator — not weather to defeat.
parallax_mid.body: The team returns to mountains because silence there is honest — ridges erase distance until patience becomes visible. This frame is a reminder: cinematic travel dignifies waiting.

values_section.title: Story first — hierarchy never
values_section.intro: You will not find reporting lines here — only shared devotion to alley steam, coastal salt, and night rain wired through neon. We argue like editors, wander like students, return like locals-in-training.

patience.title: Patience

proximity.title: Proximity

closing.title: Say hello — we answer like travelers, not desks.
closing.body: If our atlas reads cinematic, it is because humans carried its humidity across drafts and tide clocks. Reach out when you want routes that respect silence as much as spectacle.

s01.descriptor: Listens through the lens until fog agrees to stay a little longer.
s01.verse: Mountains teach patience to anyone brave enough to wait without checking the time.
s01.vietnam_anchor: Mostly traced along Sapa terraces — mist as co-director, boots never arriving clean.
s01.p1: Lan treats photography like field recording: tripod low, breath slower than the shutter, waiting until a ridge stops pretending to be a postcard. People ask for ‘golden hour’; she waits for the hour when gold feels embarrassed — when cloud bruises the ridgeline and a farmer’s tarp snaps like a gentle cymbal.
s01.p2: Her Vietnam is not iconography. It is condensation on a bus window, plastic stools stacked before dawn, the polite silence between two scooters negotiating a curve that should not exist. The archive she leaves behind is warm because she refuses to steal dignity for contrast.
s01.portrait_alt: Lan outdoors in soft light, holding a camera at her chest.
s01.secondary_alt: River mist at dawn along an embankment.

s02.descriptor: Writes with appetite — sentences seasoned before geography.
s02.verse: Alley kitchens refuse abstraction; steam insists on specifics.
s02.vietnam_anchor: Saigon and Huế kitchens — charcoal hiss, broth fogging glasses, interviews whispered between batches.
s02.p1: Minh arrives as a guest who refuses to narrate from above. He sits where bowls steam his notebook shut; he learns names before dishes. His Vietnam chapters begin with verbs — frying, folding, laughing at a mistake — because hospitality here corrects your posture before your itinerary.
s02.p2: Exploration, for him, is not discovery as conquest. It is letting a place interrupt your cleverness. When he writes about Vietnam, you taste metal spoons, hear plastic curtains slap rain, feel the shy generosity of someone sliding another stool closer without asking permission.
s02.portrait_alt: Minh smiling slightly, seated in warm indoor light.
s02.secondary_alt: Evening street scene with lanterns and motion blur.

s03.descriptor: Collects sound the way others collect stamps — proof of honest motion.
s03.verse: The coast keeps time with nets and tide, not notifications.
s03.vietnam_anchor: Recording passes through Phú Yên dawn markets and Central Coast roads — salt as percussion.
s03.p1: Hải walks with microphones like lantern light: close enough to hear intimacy, respectful enough not to stage it. Motorbikes become chords; waves become rests; vendors calling prices overlap like polite jazz. His Vietnam is audible before it is visible — you recognize place when your chest learns its tempo.
s03.p2: He hates ‘immersive’ as marketing. Immersion, for him, is humidity in the mic windscreen, laughter ruined by wind, a dog barking on beat. When we stitch journeys together, his captures remind us exploration is sensory fidelity — not a brand promise.
s03.portrait_alt: Hải looking thoughtfully past the camera in natural light.

s04.descriptor: Maps emotion onto geography until both admit they are the same story.
s04.verse: Rain reorganizes cities emotionally before it reorganizes traffic.
s04.vietnam_anchor: Night walks in Đà Nẵng and Hội An — neon dragged through puddles, bridges as emotional hinges.
s04.p1: Thu edits the atlas like a film: pacing matters more than coverage. She refuses to flatten provinces into bullet points; she lets rivers carry paragraphs, lets mountain passes interrupt chapters so breath catches where legs once burned. Her Vietnam rewards curiosity without demanding speed.
s04.p2: She believes travelers deserve intimacy without surveillance — suggestions instead of commands, margins instead of marquees. If Đất Việt feels cinematic, it is because Thu insists every route keeps room for the scene you cannot schedule: an auntie’s joke, a missed turn that becomes the story.
s04.portrait_alt: Thu turned slightly toward warm light, contemplative portrait.
s04.secondary_alt: Urban street at night with reflections on wet pavement.

philosophy.title: Slow travel, sensory honesty, atmosphere before logistics
philosophy.p1: We resist optimization language — no funnels disguised as poetry. Services breathe through emotional immersion: fog as punctuation, broth steam as orientation, lantern blush as clock.
philosophy.p2_lead: Authentic discovery means granting places their uneven rhythms — scooters arguing at intersections, sudden rain improvising a roof chorus, elders claiming sidewalks with low plastic stools.
philosophy.p2_emphasis: Sensory storytelling stays our north star; anything transactional must stay quieter than the alley kitchens we praise.

ch01.title: Lantern nights
ch01.verse: Silk light negotiates with shadow until the street forgets hurry.
ch01.body: A chapter written in blush and brass — reflections gathered on water, vendors pausing mid-sentence, the humid vowels of evening eased into amber.

ch02.title: Fog & pine
ch02.verse: Mountains borrow pencil from clouds; terraces erase, then return.
ch02.body: Pine resin and drizzle become a single scent. Roads narrow until headlights feel like conversation — one beam acknowledging another through the mute grammar of fog.

ch03.title: Alley kitchens
ch03.verse: Charcoal hisses behind modest doors — supper before introductions.
ch03.body: Steam carries plot: shallots sweating, fish sauce brightening air, plastic stools claiming sidewalk like honest punctuation. Noise is intimacy here; appetite is orientation.

ch04.title: Coastal silence
ch04.verse: Salt writes a thin script on skin; horizons refuse deadlines.
ch04.body: Fishing arcs at dawn, tarps snapping polite greetings, scooters leaning into bends that smell of midday catch — the coast as exhale, rhythm measured by tide instead of clock.

ch05.title: Neon rain
ch05.verse: Color dragged through puddles — city as wet manuscript.
ch05.body: Rain collaborates with fluorescence; scooters sketch light trails; awnings drum a tempo you walk inside. Nothing is sterile — texture arrives with sound.
ch05.hint: Urban drizzle, signage bleed, motion suggested — not spectacle for its own sake.

ch06.title: Coffee corners
ch06.verse: Phin drip slows clocks; condensation is its own punctuation.
ch06.body: Egg foam, slow glasses, tiled floors recording decades of chair scrapes — cafés as editorial rooms where Vietnam edits the afternoon into patience, humor, and small sweetness.

ch07.title: River light
ch07.verse: Morning lifts in thin sheets — water holding sky until both agree.
ch07.body: Misty embankments, washing lines echoing bridges, boats stitching currents with diesel patience — rivers organize cities emotionally before they organize them geographically.

ch08.title: Hidden courtyards
ch08.verse: Thresholds earned quiet — courtyards hum with private weather.
ch08.body: Walls cup sound differently than streets; bonsai and laundry negotiate sunlight; tea cools while neighbors trade news across wells of shade — domestic mythologies held in tile.

ch09.title: Train street echoes
ch09.verse: Metal as corridor; houses leaning in until whistles realign space.
ch09.body: Folded chairs, sudden hush, breath shared with strangers — proximity staged without performance. The train passes; ordinary life reasserts itself like a tide.

ch10.title: Mountain roads
ch10.verse: Curves teach humility; vistas repay it with silence you can wear.
ch10.body: Switchbacks sketch nerve against beauty — rice terraces, limestone sentinels, mist erasing distance until the next bend reintroduces the world with gentler contrast.
